latest.title: Your Driver Defaults Are Fine. Until They're Not.
latest.description: Things always work on your machine - the problem is that the defaults that make local development frictionless can be silently wrong in production. This article walks through exactly which settings will betray you, why, and how the amazon-documentdb-python-client wrapper fixes them automatically for your Amazon DocumentDB deployments so you can deploy on a Friday at 4:58 PM and actually make it home for Silo episodes (no spoilers here).

latest.description: A sample, portable design for running model-generated code with defense in depth — a trusted broker process and an unprivileged, network-isolated executor, talking over a Unix-domain socket. A reference to learn from and adapt, not a drop-in production system.

latest.title: Connect Amazon QuickSight to Snowflake with Per-User Identity Propagation Using Microsoft Entra ID OAuth
latest.description: Organizations that use Snowflake as their data warehouse and Amazon QuickSight as their business intelligence tool often need more than a simple shared-credential connection. They need per-user identity propagation — where each analyst's queries run under their own Snowflake identity, enabling row-level security, audit trails, and centralized access control.
